0f47b1240c739fefb0472e4f73ac71a2c8b6d927:DOWNLOADS.md:333:> The tasks are **generated**, so there is no dataset file to fetch: the pin is this package version plus the seed and the item count in `data/reasoning_gym/prepare.py`. Install it into the platform interpreter -- the check imports it inside the verification namespace. The pool itself is not a download either: `prepare.py` writes it from this version plus the seed, and `POOL_SHA256` in `data/reasoning_gym.py` pins the result, so the only declared dependency is this package. Trap 1: the extras (`reasoning-gym[scoring]`) pull an LLM-judge cascade; the 89 families used here are exactly the ones whose scorer is deterministic and offline in this version, measured rather than assumed (see `prepare.py`). Trap 2: installing it pins `click>=8.3`, while a `ray 2.52.1` in this interpreter wants `click!=8.3.*` -- a warning only, and nothing this platform imports uses either.
